subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

It is a sin against God and humanity to _________ places of religious worship.
solution:
The correct answer is '**desecrate**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**desecrate**" means to treat (a sacred place or thing) with violent disrespect; violate. (अपवित्र करना)
 
• Desecrating places of worship is considered highly offensive and wrong by both religious and societal standards.
 
• The other options: "**upright**," "**disapprove**," and "**modest**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *It is a sin against God and humanity to **desecrate__** places of religious worship.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Upright (ईमानदार)**: means strictly honorable or honest.
 
• **Disapprove (अस्वीकृत करना)**: means to have an unfavorable opinion about something.
 
• **Modest (विनम्र)**: means unassuming or moderate in the estimation of one's abilities or achievements.
